_readme: CENTRAL CONFIGURATION. Every value marked TODO in docs/SETUP_CHECKLIST.md must be replaced with verified information before launch. Empty strings mean 'not configured' and the related feature hides itself. Never put passwords, private keys or API secrets in this file: it is published with the website.

brand.name: [Brand Name]
brand.tagline: Weekend trips to the northern hills, planned around students.
brand.description: A Lahore-based group-travel project organising affordable, carefully planned trips to Northern Pakistan for university students, starting with the Galiyat hills.

forms._modeHelp: off = no network request; the form offers WhatsApp/email instead. test = sends to the Apps Script endpoint, rows go to the 'Test' tab and a banner warns visitors. live = real submissions. See docs/GOOGLE_SHEETS_SETUP.md.

operator._help: Only fill these in with details you can prove. Nothing here is shown on the site while verified is false.

seo.defaultTitle: Student group trips from Lahore to Northern Pakistan
seo.defaultDescription: Affordable, carefully planned group trips for university students in Lahore, starting with a proposed weekend in Nathiagali and Ayubia.

analytics._help: Disabled by default. If you enable analytics, update the privacy policy first.

home._heroHelp: Leave empty to use the illustrated, parallax hero. Set to an image key from content/images.json (a real photo) to use a photograph instead.
